items.title: R863: load extension-lib 1.6 manga extensions
items.summary:
## Problem

After R814 (#853), the Keiyoushi catalogue lists again, but only the 1157 lib-1.4
extensions. R814 deliberately drops the 213 lib-1.6 entries from the listing
because the loader would reject them at install time, and listing an install that
then fails is worse than not listing it.

Once R861 has implemented the TachiyomiX 1.6 source contract and R862 reads the
declared lib version, that filter and the loader bound are the only things still
hiding the remaining 16% of the catalogue.
